Looking for an ottoman bed with proper storage? The Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base is an end-opening gas lift ottoman bed base, handmade in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Hydraulic gas struts lift the whole mattress platform on a hinge, so you reach the storage underneath without taking the mattress off first. Choose it if you have no spare wardrobe space for bedding, suitcases or seasonal clothes: from £220.99 in Single 3ft to £363.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

What is a gas lift bed?

A gas lift bed uses hydraulic gas struts to lift the whole mattress platform on a hinge, opening up a large storage compartment underneath without needing to move the mattress off first. It's the most space-efficient way to add hidden storage to a UK bedroom, from £220.99.

Ottoman bed vs divan bed

A divan bed is an upholstered box base, usually with drawers or with no storage at all. An ottoman bed is a divan whose whole mattress platform lifts on gas struts, opening the full footprint of the bed as storage. Eagle Bed's gas lift base starts at £220.99 in Single 3ft.

Base Storage access Best for From price
Ottoman Gas Lift Divan Base (this base) Whole platform lifts from the end Most storage; clear floor at the foot of the bed £220.99
Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base Whole platform lifts from the side Small rooms; bed against a wall at the foot £249.99
Multi Mini Line Divan Ottoman Bed Gas lift base with matching upholstered headboard Buyers who want base and headboard as one finished look £324.99
Cambridge Panel Storage Bed Fixed pull-out drawers No lifting; open one drawer at a time £259.99

The end-opening hydraulic gas lift mechanism gives access to the underbed storage space even with a mattress in place, and a firm platform top supports the mattress across its whole footprint. Compatible with all Eagle Bed headboards and available in a wide range of fabrics.

Ottoman, drawers or plain frame?

Gas lift ottoman — the whole mattress platform lifts on hydraulic struts, so you reach the full under-bed area without moving the mattress. Most storage of the three. Choose end-lift (this base, from £220.99) if you have clear floor space at the foot of the bed; choose side-lift (Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base, from £249.99) if the bed sits against a wall at the foot and you have space at one side. Both need room above to swing the platform open.

Divan with drawers — fixed drawers built into the base (Cambridge, Oxford and Sussex Panel Storage Beds, from £259.99). Less total space than an ottoman, but no lifting, and you can open one drawer at a time. Needs clear floor in front of the drawer side.

Plain upholstered frame — no built-in storage (Mirror Strip Sunrise Bed from £285.99, Hilton Wingback Bed from £337.99). Choose this if you already have storage elsewhere, or want the lowest, lightest look.

You're viewing: an end-lift gas lift ottoman divan base.

Ottoman divan bed or divan base with drawers?

This base is an ottoman divan: a divan base whose top lifts on gas struts, opening one large space for duvets, suitcases and seasonal clothes. If you would rather pull out drawers for everyday clothes and linen, the Divan Storage Base with Drawers starts at £168.99 and needs clear floor in front of the drawers instead of headroom above. Compare every base in our divan beds collection.

Will it fit?

Mattress sizes below are UK standards. Measure the wall the bed will sit against, then the floor space left in front, and leave at least 60cm walking space at one side. Because this base is end-lift, keep the floor clear at the foot of the bed so the platform can open.

Size Mattress (UK standard) Price

Small Double (4FT) 120 x 190cm £253.99
Standard Double (4FT6) 135 x 190cm £272.99
King (5FT) 150 x 200cm £305.99
Super-King (6FT) 180 x 200cm £363.99

Still unsure? See our UK bed sizes guide or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com with your room measurements and we'll tell you which size fits.

Fabrics: Available in Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Custom fabric and colour options available on request. Order free fabric swatches.

Pair it with our Firm Memory Foam Mattress (from £142.99) for a complete bed and mattress set. Free delivery across Great Britain included.

The whole footprint of the bed opens as storage, so there is room under the mattress for bedding, suitcases and out-of-season clothes. Keep the floor clear at the foot of the bed so the platform can swing open. If you would rather lift from the side, see the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

How does a gas lift ottoman bed work?

Hydraulic gas struts lift the whole mattress platform on a hinge, opening the storage underneath while the mattress stays in place.

What is the difference between an ottoman bed and a divan bed?

A divan is a box base, often with drawers or no storage. An ottoman is a divan whose whole platform lifts on gas struts, giving you the full footprint as storage. Our ottoman vs divan guide explains more.

Does it work with my own headboard?

The base is compatible with all Eagle Bed headboards and comes in a wide range of fabrics.

Is delivery really free?

Yes. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) and usually takes 3–5 working days from our own team. Northern Ireland delivery is £90.

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.
